title: Complete Segal realization of enriched nerves preserves pointwise colimits
statement:
Use the spaces, coherent diagrams and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the small simplicial categories and derived coherent nerve $\mathbf RN_{\mathrm{hc}}$ of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and fixed universes enlarged when necessary. Let $\mathcal S=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathbf{Kan})$ be the infinity category of small spaces of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces] and $\Delta$ the ordinary category of nonempty finite ordinals $[n]=\{0,\ldots,n\}$ and weakly increasing maps. Put $\mathcal P_\Delta=\operatorname{Fun}(N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}),\mathcal S)$ for simplicial spaces, where $N$ is the ordinary nerve. There is a coherent realization functor
$$\mathfrak L:\mathcal P_\Delta\longrightarrow\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$$
with the following properties. A coherent cocone in $\mathcal P_\Delta$ is colimiting whenever its evaluation at every $[n]$ is colimiting in spaces, and $\mathfrak L$ carries every such pointwise-colimiting cocone to a colimit cocone in $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$. For every small simplicial category $A$ with Kan mapping simplicial sets, let $O_A$ be its object set and define its enriched Segal nerve $B(A)$ by
$$B(A)_n=\coprod_{(x_0,\ldots,x_n)\in O_A^{n+1}}\ \prod_{r=1}^n\langle A(x_{r-1},x_r)\rangle,$$
where $\langle K\rangle$ is the space represented by a Kan replacement for $K$ and the empty product at $n=0$ is the point; interior faces compose consecutive arrows, endpoint faces omit the first or last arrow, and degeneracies insert identities. Simplicial functors act on tuples and mapping spaces, so $B$ is coherent and natural. There is a coherent natural equivalence
$$\vartheta_A:\mathfrak L(B(A))\simeq\mathbf RN_{\mathrm{hc}}(A).$$
For every simplicial functor $f:A\to A'$, $\vartheta$ identifies the induced maps coherently, with all higher compatibilities for strings of functors. The object set may be empty, and the Kan mapping spaces need not be discrete or nonempty.

source.place: Rezk, A model for the homotopy theory of homotopy theory, Theorem 7.2, Proposition 9.1 and Section 12 (complete-Segal localization of simplicial spaces). Bergner, Complete Segal spaces arising from simplicial categories, https://math.ucr.edu/~jbergner/CSSFunctors.pdf, Section 4, printed p.11, last two paragraphs (comparison with the coherent nerve), Section 5, printed pp.12-13 (enriched nerve and completion), and Theorem 6.1, printed pp.13-14 (natural completion zigzag). Bergner, Three models for the homotopy theory of homotopy theories, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0504334, Theorems 6.3 and 8.6 (the nerve/inclusion model comparisons). The coherent functor and colimit formulation is agent-specified from these model comparisons, not a verbatim theorem of either paper. Read online in the second reading; no Stacks tag states this result.
